result.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
result.summary: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「视野外因果演化」任务，要求视频模型渲染事件后推断其对世界实体的后果，并给出 EvoWorld 基线：由 VLM 充当「世界大脑」观察已生成片段、维护世界状态并推理状态转移，段自回归渲染器负责实现，另配套数据与评测基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「维护并更新显式世界状态」与「像素渲染」分离的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的持续维护与条件化生成提供问题表述参照；事件—后果—再现的评测设计也可供核查状态更新与因果一致性评价时参考。
